you: Write a short markdown answer with two level-2 headings and a three item bullet list about the color blue.
claude: What Blue Is

Blue sits between green and violet on the visible spectrum, with wavelengths of roughly 450 to 495 nanometers. It is one of the three primary colors of light.

Where Blue Shows Up

- The sky looks blue because air scatters short wavelengths more than long ones.
- Deep water appears blue since it absorbs red light and reflects blue.
- Blue pigments like ultramarine were once rarer and costlier than gold.
